rule.eligible_choice: Among methods satisfying all gates choose lowest max(relative overall, daily-maximum and rise MAE), within 1 percent prefer D_dynamic, then W, G_Logistic, G_HGB. If none eligible retain B and state unmet requirements. Report all candidates, not only successful results.
rule.interpretation: Numerical development tolerances, not measured economic optima or a guarantee of improvement; calibration and alarm metrics supplement regression results.
